planned_title: Could a Robot Survive a Night on Mars?
spoken: On Mars, minus 90 degrees. the night can fall Batteries hate deep cold, like your phone on a frozen day, so rovers burn power just to keep their insides warm. In 2009, Spirit got stuck and couldn't catch the winter sun.
